definitions.explanation: The fourth month of the year. In Japan, April marks the beginning of the school year and fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {四月|しがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{四月|しがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Cherry blossoms are beautiful in April.

examples.japanese: {四月|しがつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まります→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
{四月|しがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友|とも}だち→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went cherry blossom viewing with friends in April.

examples.japanese: {四月|しがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かくて→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧、⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: April is warm, and it's pleasant to play outside, isn't it?

notes:
{四月|しがつ} is April - literally "month four."

PRONUNCIATION:
Uses し (not よん) for 4. Special readings: {四月|しがつ}, ⟦{七月|しちがつ}→七月：00667_shichigatsu⟧, ⟦{九月|くがつ}→九月：00646_kugatsu⟧.

CULTURAL SIGNIFICANCE:
April is the season of beginnings in Japan:
- ⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧: School entrance ceremonies
- ⟦{入社式|にゅうしゃしき}→入社式：18833_nyuushashiki⟧: Company joining ceremonies
- ⟦{新年度|しんねんど}→新年度：15459_shinnendo⟧: New fiscal year begins
- ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧: Cherry blossom season
- ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧: Cherry blossom viewing

EXPRESSIONS:
- {四月|しがつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧: to start from April
- {四月|しがつ}⟦{一日|ついたち}→一日：10993_tsuitachi⟧: April 1st (new fiscal year start)
